title: Uh Oh | The Jobs Report
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: September NFP 29k vs 90k expected, AHE 0.1%; labor canary showing early AI disruption (insurance/financial jobs) but household survey strong.
Weak jobs kills an October hike; Fed wants to cut, not hike; one-and-done hike more plausible.
AI job losses masked by AI buildout spending; canaries are AI underwriters (OpenAI/Anthropic) and the labor market.
